entities.name: Ljubomir Simović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ljubomir Simović was a Serbian writer, playwright, scriptwriter and academic. He was a member of the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts. His works have been translated in more than twenty languages.
